تتعاهدون (form VI)
# تَتَعَاهَدُونَ (tataʕāhadūna) /ta.ta.ʕaː.ha.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تُتَعَاهَدُونَ (tutaʕāhadūna) /tu.ta.ʕaː.ha.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
